correctness.rationale: Conditional on the full color sequence the component trees are independent Hoppe trees; Pólya color counts are Dirichlet-multinomial. The conditional beta-binomial coupling makes the size of a disjoint root group stochastically strictly decreasing with the first group size; Hoppe leaf count under sequential attachment is nondecreasing. This proves strict negative regression for any strictly increasing functions. First and mixed moments follow via the explicitly stated scalar recurrences (including H) from exact increments and Dirichlet-multinomial size products. A conditional variance inequality gives L_i=N_i/2+O_{L²}(sqrt n), yielding the half-Dirichlet L² limit and covariance/correlation constants. Exact checker passed 1001 assertions across 14779 attachment histories; experiments alone do not prove infinite quantification.
